trust_decision.summary: Whether a request-derived or configuration-derived string may be written into the WAP consent page as markup; decided per variable in the FreeMarker template by explicit ?html filters, with the two pre-existing display strings encoded server-side in Java instead.

landing_point.why: An engineer reading 'reflected XSS in the OAuth2/OIDC wap consent page' opens the only wap template and finds the WML form action written from ${target!'.'}, where target is the resource path plus the raw query string built in ConsentRequiredResource.getDataModel; the same file writes ${response_type} and ${client_id} unescaped while its neighbouring parameters already use ?html.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /oauth2/authorize and POST /oauth2/device/user with display=wap (hidden fields)
GET /oauth2/authorize and POST /oauth2/device/user (shared consent data model)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names only the wap page, and the other consent renderers apparently have their own protection: page/popup/touch escape every request parameter with ?js_string and the XUI Handlebars template uses triple-stash but relies on the server-side ESAPI encoding done in ConsentRequiredResource, so a solver can call those paths already handled and out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The wap form must still post back to the exact original target (path plus redirect_uri/scope/state/acr query) and the two display strings must be rendered exactly once: display_name and display_description are already ESAPI HTML-encoded in the model, so adding ?html to them (or ESAPI-encoding the new raw display_scope list in Java before the template's ?html) double-encodes them as &lt;... and changes the page.

O6_input_shapes: composite value: target = resource path + '?' + raw query string, so arbitrary extra query parameters are carried inside one interpolated attribute
simple string request parameters echoed into hidden inputs: response_type and client_id
sequence versus scalar: display_scope is now a List<String> while the same name can arrive as a single query parameter value
configuration-derived scope description strings (client/provider scope translations) rendered as a sequence

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A wap-specific error or code-verification template under templates/wap/ that echoes request parameters without ?html
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ExceptionHandler hardcodes the 'page' folder for error pages (openam-oauth2/src/main/java/org/forgerock/oauth2/restlet/ExceptionHandler.java:137), so a maintainer making the error/device pages display-aware would naturally add templates/wap/*.ftl next to this one and copy its three-line form pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second model key populated straight from getQuery().getValuesMap() and rendered raw as an HTML attribute value
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The merge of every raw query parameter into the template model is the established idiom of this class, and the fix itself had to place its new display_scope entry after that merge for the same reason; a maintainer adding another consent field would follow it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A raw (unescaped) model field rendered through a Handlebars triple-stash in the XUI consent template
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This template already renders scope and claim names with {{{this.name}}}, trusting the server-side ESAPI encoding, so exposing the new raw display_scope list to the pageData model without escaping would be an easy, plausible change.

O9_family: Reflected cross-site scripting (CWE-79): missing HTML escaping of request- and configuration-derived values when a FreeMarker template renders the consent page

O10_build.toolchain: Maven multi-module (parent org.openidentityplatform.openam:openam 16.1.2-SNAPSHOT); the openam-oauth2 module depends on openam-core, openam-rest, openam-shared, openam-tokens and the ForgeRock openid-connect-module, so the first build needs the Maven repositories
O10_build.project_tests: openam-oauth2/src/test/java/org/forgerock/oauth2/restlet/AuthorizeResourceTest.java exists but covers request handling only, not the consent data model or the FreeMarker templates; the fix diff adds no tests.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape only the value that reproduces, ${target}, in the wap template (or ESAPI-encode the echoed parameters in getDataModel instead of the template), leaving response_type, client_id and the new display_scope list untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: openam-oauth2/src/main/resources/templates/touch/authorize.ftl:56 has a typo ('isplayName' instead of 'displayName'); cosmetic, no security effect.

No live XSS was found on the page/popup/touch or openam-ui consent renderers at the pinned commit: page/popup/touch use ?js_string/?html and the XUI template's triple-stash depends on the ESAPI encoding at ConsentRequiredResource.java:118; that cross-module dependency is recorded as O2, not pursued further.
